🇨🇦❗️#AstonVilla has made concrete exploratory inquiries for #David and is seriously evaluating the option of signing him through a loan formula. In the event the Canadian leaves, #Juventus would not be caught unprepared and has already identified the ideal replacement: #Zirkzee. The Dutch forward would not represent the ideal profile for #Spalletti, but he would still be a solution welcomed by both the coach and the club.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

According to La Stampa, #Juventus has added the name of Robin #Risser from #Lens to their goalkeeper list. 🇫🇷The French club does not intend to give any discounts and values the player's price tag at around 35 million euros 💰#juventusnews24[Juventus News 24]

🇮🇹👀 #Lazio has resumed the evaluation of the possibility to sign #Miretti, who is considered by #Gattuso to be an extremely versatile player. They are working on the transfer formula: the idea of the biancocelesti would be to set up the deal on the basis of a loan with an option to buy, destined to become an obligation under certain conditions. A formula that could allow them to reinforce the midfield without immediately facing a permanent investment.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🔥 #Juventus and #Spalletti can no longer for the one between the posts after the latest flop from Michele #DiGregorio.🧐 Next week could be decisive: the Continassa management is looking to find a new placement on the mercato for the ex #Monza goalkeeper and, in the meantime, is accelerating for his replacement.📋 #Suzuki, #Vicario and #Trubin are the hottest names on the bianconero list, while a new and ‘desperate' attempt for Dibu #Martínez cannot be ruled out.✍️ @GiokerMusso[Calciomercato IT]
